questions.subject: MLOps
questions.question: Explain the difference between model versioning and model monitoring in MLOps.
questions.ideal_answer: model versioning and model monitoring differ in several ways: model versioning is artifact tracking (works by experiment reproducibility) whereas model monitoring is production model health (works by detecting drift and degradation). model versioning is typically used for MLflow, DVC, Weights & Biases, while model monitoring is used for data drift, concept drift, prediction drift. Example demonstrating model versioning: model registry: staging, production, archived. Example demonstrating model monitoring: Evidently, WhyLabs, Fiddler.
